library_preparation_preflight.summary: End-to-end configuration loading requires a live Vault server; the normal dependency closure is otherwise sufficient. [Spring Cloud Vault Quick Start](https://docs.spring.io/spring-cloud-vault/reference/quickstart.html)

deterministic_setup.reason: Pinned official Vault image; this version is referenced by Spring Cloud Vault release tooling and supports the documented integration-test workflow. [Spring Cloud Vault releases](https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-vault/releases)

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Start an isolated ephemeral Vault server from the declared image, preferably dev mode over HTTP for baseline KV/config-data coverage. Dynamically map its port, wait for readiness, provision deterministic KV data, configure spring.application.name, spring.config.import=vault://, spring.cloud.vault.uri, spring.cloud.vault.scheme=http, spring.cloud.vault.authentication, and the test-only authentication value, then always stop and remove the server. Exercise default/contextual paths, profiles, optional imports, and fail-fast behavior. Use a test-local truststore if TLS-specific coverage is attempted.
risks: The upstream quick start uses HTTPS and generated certificates; HTTP dev mode will not cover TLS behavior.
Tests require a working Docker daemon and reliable container cleanup.
